mapper.sql: and (instance_status = #{instanceStatus} or (instance_status in ('FAILED', 'PARTIAL_FAILED', 'FAILED_DRY_RUN') and #{instanceStatus} in ('SUCCESS', 'SUCCESS_DRY_RUN') and #{successPartitionCount} > 0 and #{failedPartitionCount} = 0 and not exists ( select 1 from batch.job_partition jp where jp.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and jp.job_instance_id = #{id} and jp.partition_status <> 'SUCCESS' )) or instance_status not in ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'PARTIAL_FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'TERMINATED', 'SUCCESS_DRY_RUN', 'FAILED_DRY_RUN'))
mapper.select: select ji.* from batch.job_instance ji join batch.workflow_node_run n on n.job_instance_id=ji.id and n.node_type='JOB' join batch.workflow_run w on w.id=n.workflow_run_id and w.tenant_id=ji.tenant_id join batch.trigger_request tr on tr.id=w.trigger_request_id and tr.tenant_id=w.tenant_id where ji.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and tr.request_id=#{requestId} and ji.job_code=#{jobCode} and not exists (select 1 from batch.workflow_node_run newer where newer.workflow_run_id=n.workflow_run_id and newer.node_code=n.node_code and newer.run_seq > n.run_seq)
mapper.insert:
with claimed_key as ( insert into batch.job_instance_dedup_key ( tenant_id, dedup_key, run_attempt, first_biz_date ) values ( #{tenantId}, #{dedupKey}, #{runAttempt}, coalesce(#{bizDate}, CURRENT_DATE) ) on conflict (tenant_id, dedup_key, run_attempt) do nothing returning 1 ) insert into batch.job_instance ( tenant_id, job_definition_id, trigger_request_id, job_code, instance_no, biz_date, trigger_type, instance_status, batch_no, operator_id, rerun_flag, retry_flag, rerun_reason, related_file_id, parent_instance_id, queue_code, worker_group, priority, dedup_key, run_attempt, job_definition_version, rerun_policy_snapshot, version, expected_partition_count, success_partition_count, failed_partition_count, trace_id, params_snapshot, calendar_code, data_interval_start, data_interval_end, high_water_mark_in, high_water_mark_out, result_summary, deadline_at, expected_duration_seconds, sla_alerted_at, replay_session_id, dry_run ) select #{tenantId}, #{jobDefinitionId}, #{triggerRequestId}, #{jobCode}, #{instanceNo}, coalesce(#{bizDate}, CURRENT_DATE), #{triggerType}, #{instanceStatus}, #{batchNo}, #{operatorId}, #{rerunFlag}, #{retryFlag}, #{rerunReason}, #{relatedFileId}, #{parentInstanceId}, #{queueCode}, #{workerGroup}, #{priority}, #{dedupKey}, #{runAttempt}, #{jobDefinitionVersion}, #{rerunPolicySnapshot,jdbcType=VARCHAR}::jsonb, #{version}, #{expectedPartitionCount}, #{successPartitionCount}, #{failedPartitionCount}, #{traceId}, #{paramsSnapshot,jdbcType=VARCHAR}::jsonb, #{calendarCode}, #{dataIntervalStart}, #{dataIntervalEnd}, #{highWaterMarkIn}, #{highWaterMarkOut}, #{resultSummary,jdbcType=VARCHAR}::jsonb, #{deadlineAt}, #{expectedDurationSeconds}, #{slaAlertedAt}, #{replaySessionId},
#{dryRun} false
from claimed_key
mapper.update: update batch.job_instance set instance_status = #{instanceStatus}, success_partition_count = #{successPartitionCount}, failed_partition_count = #{failedPartitionCount}, cancelled_partition_count = #{cancelledPartitionCount}, terminated_partition_count = #{terminatedPartitionCount}, result_summary = #{resultSummary,jdbcType=VARCHAR}::jsonb, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, failure_class = #{failureClass,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, version = version + 1, updated_at = current_timestamp where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id = #{id} and version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE batch.job_instance SET execution_started_at = COALESCE(execution_started_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), updated_at = CASE WHEN execution_started_at IS NULL THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE updated_at END WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND finished_at IS NULL AND instance_status IN ('CREATED', 'WAITING', 'READY', 'RUNNING', 'PAUSED')
mapper.select: select ji.* from batch.job_instance ji join batch.job_definition jd on jd.id = ji.job_definition_id and jd.tenant_id = ji.tenant_id where ji.instance_status = 'RUNNING' and ji.execution_started_at is not null and > 0 and ji.execution_started_at < current_timestamp - ( * interval '1 second') -- 首次实际执行入口才是超时起点；已派发或已认领但未进入执行的等待不计时。 and exists ( select 1 from batch.job_task jt where jt.tenant_id = ji.tenant_id and jt.job_instance_id = ji.id and jt.task_status = 'RUNNING' ) order by ji.execution_started_at asc, ji.id asc limit #{limit}

select ji.* from batch.job_instance ji join batch.trigger_request tr on tr.id = ji.trigger_request_id and tr.tenant_id = ji.tenant_id join batch.job_definition jd on jd.id = ji.job_definition_id and jd.tenant_id = ji.tenant_id where ji.instance_status = 'CREATED' -- T1 已提交、T2 尚未产生任何子项时，请求通常为 ACCEPTED；但 consumer 的状态 -- 回写和 T2 事务不是同一原子提交单元，异常窗口中也可能已是 LAUNCHED。 -- 零 partition/task/workflow 才是“从未实际派发”的事实判据，不能因 LAUNCHED 标签跳过恢复。 and ( tr.request_status in ('ACCEPTED', 'LAUNCHED') -- 仅兼容旧版本曾把“同一 request 重投”误记为 DUPLICATE 的遗留行； -- trigger_request_id 必须是当前请求自身，不能重跑另一请求的业务去重结果。 or (tr.request_status = 'DUPLICATE' and ji.trigger_request_id = tr.id) ) and ji.created_at < #{olderThan} and not exists ( select 1 from batch.job_partition jp where jp.job_instance_id = ji.id ) and not exists ( select 1 from batch.job_task jt where jt.job_instance_id = ji.id ) and not exists ( select 1 from batch.workflow_run wr where wr.related_job_instance_id = ji.id ) order by ji.id asc limit #{limit}
select count(1) from batch.job_instance where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and instance_status in ('READY', 'RUNNING')

select count(1) from batch.job_instance ji where ji.instance_status in ('READY', 'RUNNING') and ji.tenant_id in ( select tenant_id from batch.tenant_quota_policy where enabled = true and fair_share_group = #{fairShareGroup} )
select count(1) from batch.job_instance where instance_status in ('READY', 'RUNNING')

with active_children as ( select tenant_id, job_instance_id from batch.job_partition where partition_status in ('CREATED', 'WAITING', 'READY', 'RUNNING', 'RETRYING') union select tenant_id, job_instance_id from batch.job_task where task_status in ('CREATED', 'READY', 'RUNNING') ) select count(*) from active_children child join batch.job_instance ji on ji.tenant_id = child.tenant_id and ji.id = child.job_instance_id where ji.instance_status in ( 'SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'PARTIAL_FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'TERMINATED', 'SUCCESS_DRY_RUN', 'FAILED_DRY_RUN' )

select count(1) as "totalCount", coalesce(sum(case when wf_run.run_status in ('CREATED', 'RUNNING', 'PAUSED') or exists ( select 1 from batch.workflow_node_run node_run join batch.job_instance job_instance on job_instance.tenant_id = wf_run.tenant_id and job_instance.id = node_run.job_instance_id where node_run.workflow_run_id = wf_run.id and job_instance.biz_date is not distinct from wf_run.biz_date and job_instance.dry_run = wf_run.dry_run and job_instance.instance_status in ( 'CREATED', 'WAITING', 'READY', 'RUNNING', 'PAUSED' ) ) then 1 else 0 end), 0) as "activeCount", coalesce(sum(case when wf_run.run_status = 'SUCCESS' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as "successCount", coalesce(sum(case when wf_run.run_status in ('FAILED', 'TERMINATED') then 1 else 0 end), 0) as "failedCount" from batch.workflow_run wf_run join batch.workflow_definition wf on wf.tenant_id = wf_run.tenant_id and wf.id = wf_run.workflow_definition_id where wf_run.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and wf.calendar_code = #{calendarCode} and wf_run.biz_date = #{bizDate} and wf_run.dry_run = false
select * from batch.job_instance where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and job_definition_id = #{jobDefinitionId} and instance_status = 'SUCCESS' order by finished_at desc nulls last, id desc limit 1
mapper.update: update batch.job_instance set high_water_mark_out = #{highWaterMarkOut}, updated_at = current_timestamp where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id = #{id} and #{highWaterMarkOut} ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' and ( high_water_mark_out is null or high_water_mark_out = '' or high_water_mark_out !~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' or (high_water_mark_out)::numeric < (#{highWaterMarkOut})::numeric )
